Another biometrician job, this time in New Hampshire.

 

From: On Behalf Of Catherine Callahan
Sent: 17 February 2021 17:17
Subject: Wildlife Biometrician at NH Fish and Game Department

 

The State of New Hampshire, Fish and Game Department has a full time vacancy for wildlife biometrician. Summary: Designs data collection procedures and performs data analysis for wildlife projects, employing current statistical methods and modeling techniques, and works with Wildlife Division staff to coordinate data collection for management and research purposes.  The State of NH compensation package features excellent benefits. Application close date March 5, 2021. Details in the attached job description. For further information please contact: Mark Ellingwood, Chief of Wildlife Division at (603) 271-2461.
